title: The Weakest Bound
goal: announce works for strings AND numbers. The body already tells you which capability it needs.
hints: Look at the body: what does {item} in a format string demand?
Debug would need {item:?}. Clone isn't about printing at all.
explanation: The bound is dictated by usage: `{item}` formats through Display, so `T: Display` is exactly sufficient - for &str and i32 alike. Debug is a different capability ({:?}), and Clone has nothing to do with formatting; both fail with E0277 pointing at the println. The instinct: read the body, demand precisely what it uses - the weakest bound that compiles is the most reusable signature.
